subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'plants.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bamboo is a plant.
 
 
• बांस एक पौधा है।
 
 
 
• Therefore, we need the word** 'plants.'**
 
• **Correct phrase: ***Pandas only eat fresh bamboo plants which the zoo had been importing from ........*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• Let us see the meanings of the words:
 
 
• **Food: **any nutritious substance that people or animals eat or drink or that plants absorb in order to maintain life and growth.
 
• **Plants: **a living organism of the kind exemplified by trees, shrubs, herbs, grasses, ferns, and mosses, typically growing in a permanent site, absorbing water and inorganic substances through its roots, and synthesizing nutrients in its leaves by photosynthesis using the green pigment chlorophyll.
 
• **Nourishment: **the food necessary for growth, health, and good condition.
 
• **Meal: **any of the regular occasions in a day when a reasonably large amount of food is eaten.
